entities.summary: Henry Flynt is an American philosopher, musician, writer, activist, and artist connected to the 1960s New York avant-garde. He coined the term "concept art" in the early 1960s, during which time he was associated with figures in the Fluxus scene. He later received attention for his anti-art demonstrations against New York cultural institutions in 1963 and 1964. Henry Flynt was a philosophers & thinkers from Greensboro (b. 1940, Greensboro). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
